nodes.label: Covertype Dataset (UCI, Blackard 1998)
nodes.author: Blackard, J.
nodes.rationale: 581,012 instances, 54 features, 7 classes; CC BY 4.0. Soil, wilderness, roads and fire-point features excluded because generated terrain has none.

nodes.label: Default relief 20% of elevation range
nodes.rationale: Full range gives slopes far outside training data so most cells would be OOD; 20% gives ~15 deg mean slope vs Covertype ~14 deg.

nodes.label: cloudflare.config.ts bindings (cf/config)
nodes.rationale: Bindings declared via helpers; Env type is generated by typecheck, never hand-written.

nodes.label: classTints (palette.ts)
nodes.rationale: Colours come from code; crowns modelled neutral grey

nodes.label: SPECIES Silhouette Slots (vegetation.ts)
nodes.rationale: Each class needs a distinct silhouette since walk mode shows predicted class through plant shape

nodes.label: Animal Body Animation (shader legs)
nodes.rationale: SkinnedMesh cannot be instanced; shader legs for 400-animal herd

nodes.label: Scene Frame Loop (scene.ts #tick)
nodes.rationale: Orbit draws on demand; walk mode animates; shared #time stops with reduced motion

nodes.label: Triangle Budget
nodes.rationale: 300-triangle tree would mean ~5M triangles on high

nodes.label: Custom 3D Designs and Textures for Walk Mode
nodes.norm_label: custom 3d designs and textures for walk mode

nodes.label: D10 Sim State for Ground-Scale Viewing
nodes.norm_label: d10 sim state for ground-scale viewing

nodes.label: D13 Content and Safeguards for Walk Mode
nodes.norm_label: d13 content and safeguards for walk mode
nodes.rationale: A good-looking world can make predictions feel more trustworthy than they are

nodes.label: Design Style (terminal-meets-game-launcher)
nodes.rationale: Hushed, cinematic, monospace, near-black with one muted teal accent; 4.5:1 contrast

nodes.label: Shared App State Store
nodes.rationale: Orbit and walk read the same store so switching modes loses no state

nodes.label: OOD low-trust flag (detector or range check)
nodes.norm_label: ood low-trust flag (detector or range check)

nodes.label: Educational-simulation-only notice
nodes.rationale: Never-cut item: keep even if other scope is cut.

nodes.label: Terrain-to-Habitat Classifier
nodes.rationale: Multiclass forest cover type prediction from terrain features only; the only ML component (ecology rules are hand-written assumptions).

nodes.label: LOAO macro-F1 selection rule
nodes.rationale: Written before any LOAO result; pick highest mean macro-F1, prefer simpler model within 0.01 (softmax<MLP<forest).

nodes.label: Responsible Use and Limitations
nodes.rationale: Educational only; single Colorado forest; synthetic terrain; class imbalance (macro-F1 reported); computed hillshade may differ; walk mode is a picture of predictions; no personal data.

nodes.label: Hillshade: Our Method vs Dataset (D2)
nodes.rationale: Fitted SUN positions reproduce dataset hillshade columns; remaining DEM/shadow differences measured by ablation

nodes.label: D12 Documentation for the Walkable World
nodes.norm_label: d12 documentation for the walkable world

nodes.label: Never Invent Numbers Rule
nodes.rationale: Every metric comes from model_card.json

nodes.label: Re-predict on modelVersion Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Predictions not stored; loaded world is always predicted again with current model and notice shown

nodes.label: computeFeatures
nodes.rationale: Same function in training and app prevents preprocessing drift

nodes.label: heightmapToInputs (@graze/features)
nodes.rationale: Only terrain->inputs implementation; old copies deleted after sun-angle drift

nodes.label: Elevation Band Slider (40% default)
nodes.rationale: 50% band predicts 99% Lodgepole Pine

nodes.label: Herd Simulation (not ML)
nodes.rationale: Hand-tuned ecology.json rules; deterministic; labeled Assumptions, not model output

nodes.label: Inference Web Worker
nodes.rationale: Keeps UI responsive for 16,384 cells; no server, no data leaves browser

nodes.label: Model Report reads model_card.json
nodes.rationale: Numbers exactly as pipeline produced; retraining updates report

nodes.label: D17 Custom .glb Models
nodes.rationale: Level A (vertex colours); manifest.json ships with empty slots so a missing file never 404s; loaded shapes swap in over code-built defaults and a failed slot keeps its default.

nodes.label: D9 Landscape Visuals
nodes.rationale: Vegetation instanced per predicted cover class (7 SPECIES silhouettes, seeded placement), slope blending, shoreline, animated water, sky/fog/shadows, chunked distance culling.

nodes.label: Model Credits (CREDITS.md)
nodes.rationale: One line per .glb file; no custom models added yet, so code-built shapes in flora.ts/fauna.ts are drawn for every slot.

nodes.label: three.js 0.187.0 (r187) Library Notes
nodes.rationale: Addons via three/addons; Sky and Water are WebGL-only; InstancedMesh has one bounding sphere so vegetation is chunked; SkinnedMesh cannot be instanced.

nodes.label: Team-Made-Only Asset Rule
nodes.rationale: No AI-generated assets and no downloaded libraries without a team decision.

nodes.label: No AI-Generated Assets Rule
nodes.rationale: World D9 requires procedural or team-made assets; CC0 libraries probably disallowed

nodes.label: No AI-Generated Assets Rule
nodes.rationale: All geometry and audio procedural or team-made; applies to D9 vegetation and D17 models.

nodes.label: Excluded columns (soil, wilderness, roads, fire)
nodes.rationale: Generated terrain has no soils, roads, fire history or wilderness boundaries, so a model using them could not run in the sandbox.

nodes.label: Blackard & Dean (2000) ANN vs discriminant analysis
nodes.norm_label: blackard & dean (2000) ann vs discriminant analysis

nodes.label: Leave-One-Wilderness-Area-Out (LOAO) Folds
nodes.rationale: Honest evaluation; whole unseen area resembles app use on new terrain

nodes.label: LockedTestSet / splits.lock.json
nodes.rationale: Prevents training code from reading final-test indices

nodes.label: Macro-F1 Metric
nodes.rationale: Two classes dominate Covertype so accuracy misleads

nodes.label: Random Split (optimistic)
nodes.rationale: Adjacent 30 m cells are spatially correlated and fall on both sides

nodes.label: Random-Split Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Sized grids and forest caps; depth-18 trees >700k nodes so forest capped at 25 trees depth 12

nodes.label: Model Selection Rule (D4)
nodes.rationale: Frozen before any LOAO result; mean LOAO macro-F1, within 0.01 pick simplest softmax<MLP<forest

nodes.label: Cosmetic day/night cycle
nodes.rationale: daynight.ts only lights the scene; hillshade inputs use a fixed fitted sun, and a test forbids importing @graze/features here, so time cannot change predictions.

nodes.label: Own sky and water shaders
nodes.rationale: three's Sky needs tone mapping that shifts overlay colors; Water renders scene twice. Custom shaders read depth from heightmap in one draw call.

nodes.label: Render on demand in orbit view
nodes.norm_label: render on demand in orbit view

nodes.label: PointerLockControls (three r187)
nodes.rationale: lock() needs a user gesture and can be denied, hence touch and keyboard fallbacks; cannot be verified headless.

nodes.label: D15 Exit Button and Walk Info Panel (onexit)
nodes.norm_label: d15 exit button and walk info panel (onexit)
nodes.rationale: Pointer lock hides the cursor, so an 'Esc to exit' hint is needed beside the button; all exit paths call onexit(reason) and keep position/heading.

nodes.label: D16 Animal Pace (paceScale, ANIMAL_PACE)
nodes.rationale: paceScale = min(1, ANIMAL_PACE x WALK_SPEED / medianMovingSpeed), computed from ecology.json; only the wall-clock tick rate changes so determinism is untouched; slowing also slows the whole ecosystem.

nodes.label: D6 Animals (instanced herbivore/predator)
nodes.rationale: Positions come from Role 2's sim state; no sim logic in the renderer.

nodes.label: Herd Simulation
nodes.rationale: Herbivores, predators, regrowth driven by hand-written editable ecology rules (ecology.json); rewilding score summarizes outcome.

nodes.label: Simulation is not ML
nodes.rationale: Every number is hand-picked so dynamics look plausible; no training step, so UI keeps rules visible and separate from predictions.

nodes.label: Ecology Rules (ecology.json, assumptions)
nodes.rationale: Assumptions written by the team, not model output.

nodes.label: getGroundHeight(x, z)
nodes.rationale: Bilinear interpolation of four heightmap cells (sampleHeight after worldToCellF) keeps walking smooth versus nearest-cell.

nodes.label: D12 Measurements (i7-11700, RTX 4060)
nodes.rationale: Measured on a desktop, not the team weakest laptop; 30 fps laptop target still open

nodes.label: D12 Performance and Quality Presets
nodes.rationale: Target 30+ fps on weakest laptop (unmeasured); measured 60 fps cap on i7-11700/RTX 4060; auto-downgrade guard pauses cycle then lowers preset; dispose checks with flat counts after 5 toggles.

nodes.label: D14 Ambient Backdrop is the Walk View
nodes.norm_label: d14 ambient backdrop is the walk view
nodes.rationale: Every page sits on a dimmed live ground-level view (DIM_IDLE 0.72, DIM_WALK 0); contrast must stay 4.5:1 at noon; idle cost capped at low preset/30 fps.

nodes.label: D8 Walk Mode
nodes.rationale: Diorama scale: one unit is a 30 m cell, walker is a giant (EYE_HEIGHT 0.5, WALK_SPEED 3, RUN_SPEED 7, SLOPE_LIMIT 45 deg, WADE_DEPTH_M 6); true walking speed would take 45 minutes to cross the map.

nodes.label: Shared Heightmap / Cover Map Contract
nodes.rationale: Heightmap Float32Array(16384) row-major 128x128, meters, 30 m cells; cover map Uint8Array(16384) class 0-6; per-cell class, confidence, ood flag. Source of truth docs/feature-contract.md.

nodes.label: Terrain Features (elevation, slope, aspect, hillshade, water distance)
nodes.norm_label: terrain features (elevation, slope, aspect, hillshade, water distance)

nodes.label: Cosmetic Sun Separate from Hillshade Feature
nodes.norm_label: cosmetic sun separate from hillshade feature
nodes.rationale: Hillshade is a fixed model input from the heightmap via computeFeatures; moving the sun slider changes no prediction. A test fails if world/ imports the feature code.

nodes.label: @graze/features Shared Features Contract
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth imported by both ml/ and apps/web so preprocessing cannot drift between training and inference; this is why training is in TypeScript rather than Python.

nodes.label: validateWorld
nodes.rationale: Same validation in browser before upload, Worker on save, browser after download

nodes.label: Offline Code graze1.
nodes.rationale: Deflate+base64url whole world; sharing works without deployed Worker

nodes.label: Share Link #/world/<id>
nodes.rationale: Fragment never sent to server, so works on any static host without rewrite rules

nodes.label: WORLDS_RATE_LIMIT (Workers Rate Limiting binding)
nodes.rationale: Verified GA; approximate per location; IP used only as key, never stored

nodes.label: D9 model freeze / locked test set
nodes.norm_label: d9 model freeze / locked test set

nodes.label: cf CLI (not wrangler)
nodes.rationale: Project uses the beta cf CLI; no wrangler config should be added.

nodes.label: D13 Save, Load and Share World
nodes.norm_label: d13 save, load and share world
nodes.rationale: Optional, first cut. Compact delta of seed/options/brush edits with schemaVersion+modelVersion; offline graze1 share code plus #/world/<id> link via API.

nodes.label: No pnpm packages: workspace
nodes.rationale: cf (beta) cannot build from a workspace root, and the Worker lives at the repo root

nodes.label: Hono Worker Saved-Worlds API
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare Worker (src/index.ts, D1) to save/load/share worlds; everything else works without it.

nodes.label: Role 1: World
nodes.rationale: Owns packages/sim/terrain, apps/web/src/lib/world, public/models; must not edit features, ml, herd sim or Svelte pages.

nodes.label: Project Graze
nodes.rationale: Rewilding sandbox: sculpt procedural valley, model predicts vegetation, release herds/predators. CSST 102 final project, web-based predictive ML system.

nodes.label: Team (dar3v World, Liamjandr App/Sim, Zeki-Zek ML)
nodes.norm_label: team (dar3v world, liamjandr app/sim, zeki-zek ml)

nodes.label: D11 Walk HUD and ML Tie-in
nodes.norm_label: d11 walk hud and ml tie-in

nodes.label: .glb Validation Budgets and tintMask
nodes.rationale: Triangle budgets (60 tree, 6 grass, 200 animal), 100 KB/file, origin at base, no skins; tintMask 1 for crown* materials keeps per-class and OOD tinting working.

nodes.label: One Renderer Draws at a Time
nodes.norm_label: one renderer draws at a time
nodes.rationale: Two WebGL scenes at once would double GPU memory; spike chooses Option A (backdrop renderer runs walk) or B (separate ambient scene). Never cut.

nodes.label: OOD Low-Trust Marking
nodes.rationale: Cells unlike training data are visibly marked in overlay and rendered sparse/desaturated (35% plants, 0.8x size, 80% toward grey) so low trust shows in the world; never cut.

nodes.label: App State, View Modes and Sim View
nodes.norm_label: app state, view modes and sim view

nodes.label: validateForm two-tier validation
nodes.rationale: Impossible values blocked; out-of-training-range allowed but flagged to show extrapolation

nodes.label: OOD Detector standardized-distance (D6)
nodes.rationale: Diagonal Mahalanobis / sqrt(d); only detector app runtime supports; 99th percentile threshold keeps false alarms rare

nodes.label: explainOne ±10% Perturbation Sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Local one-at-a-time perturbation, not causal reasoning

nodes.label: TypeScript ML Training Pipeline (ml/)
nodes.rationale: No ML libraries, fixed seeds, final test set pinned by hash in ml/splits.lock.json; about 2,600 lines; exported model checked against fixtures via app inference code.

nodes.label: Leave-One-Wilderness-Area-Out Validation
nodes.rationale: Honest generalization test; stratified random split is optimistic because neighboring cells are correlated.

nodes.label: D5 Overlays (cover, confidence)
nodes.rationale: Class colors come from sandbox/palette.ts because model_card.json has no color field.

nodes.label: @graze/features single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Both ml/ and apps/web import it so preprocessing cannot drift.

nodes.label: Seeded PRNG (ml/src/lib/rng.ts)
nodes.rationale: One seeded PRNG makes the same commit and data give the same model

nodes.label: TypeScript From-Scratch Training (D1)
nodes.rationale: No ML dependency: libraries' model formats would need converting to apps/web model.json; training on 150k rows takes minutes on Node 24

nodes.label: Dirty-Region Prediction Fallback
nodes.rationale: About 60x cheaper than full grid; tested equal in ml/test/dirtyRegion.test.ts

nodes.label: Measured Inference Latency (D10)
nodes.rationale: Node numbers on i7-11700; full-grid ~20 ms per edit runs off main thread

nodes.label: D10 Inference Support for Walk Mode
nodes.norm_label: d10 inference support for walk mode
